description: Initialize Next.js 15 project with all configuration files, dependency installation, and project structure. This establishes the foundation for all subsequent features.
steps: Create package.json with all required dependencies: next@latest, react@19, typescript, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss, shadcn/ui deps (@radix-ui components), drizzle-orm, drizzle-kit, @supabase/supabase-js, @supabase/ssr, recharts, leaflet, openai, pdf-lib, exceljs, papaparse, zod, next-intl (i18n), next-themes (dark mode), lucide-react (icons), vitest, @vitejs/plugin-react, playwright, @testing-library/react, eslint, prettier
Create tsconfig.json with strict mode, path aliases (@/ for src/), and proper Next.js 15 settings
Create next.config.ts (note: .ts extension for Next.js 15) with appropriate settings for the platform
Create tailwind.config.ts with custom theme colors for the carbon platform (greens, blues for sustainability theme), dark mode class strategy
Create postcss.config.mjs with tailwindcss plugin
Create drizzle.config.ts pointing to src/lib/db/schema/ with PostgreSQL dialect and supabase connection
Create vitest.config.ts with React plugin, path aliases, and coverage settings
Create playwright.config.ts with basic E2E test configuration
Create .eslintrc.json with Next.js recommended rules
Create .prettierrc with consistent formatting rules
Create .gitignore for Next.js project (node_modules, .next, .env.local, etc.)
Create .env.example with all required environment variables (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, DATABASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, etc.)
Create the folder structure: src/app/, src/lib/, src/components/ui/, src/components/features/, src/types/, src/constants/, src/hooks/, src/middleware.ts, docs/, tests/, supabase/migrations/
Create src/app/globals.css with Tailwind directives and CSS custom properties for theming
Create src/app/layout.tsx as root layout with ThemeProvider, font setup, and metadata
Create src/app/page.tsx as landing page placeholder
Create src/lib/utils.ts with cn() utility function for tailwind class merging
Run pnpm install to install all dependencies
CRITICAL: After pnpm install, read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ directory to check for documentation about Next.js latest APIs and adjust any code accordingly
Run pnpm build to verify the project compiles successfully
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build completes successfully producing a .next/ output
All configuration files are valid and properly formatted
TypeScript compilation passes with no errors
The project structure follows Next.js 15 App Router conventions
.env.example contains all necessary environment variable placeholders
verification: Run pnpm install && pnpm build and confirm exit code 0
Run pnpm lint and confirm no critical errors
